subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should the supported contract include a global group-to-main default, or only an explicit per-binding opt-in for trusted peers?
rationale: Both enable the workflow, but the global option materially broadens accidental context sharing and creates a long-lived compatibility-sensitive core configuration surface.

options.title: Per-binding only
options.body: Land only an exact-binding opt-in so every trusted group or channel is deliberately selected and all others remain isolated.

options.title: Global plus override
options.body: Allow a global group default with binding exceptions, accepting wider cross-channel and cross-account exposure risk.

options.title: Named shared sessions
options.body: Keep main private and route selected conversations into separate named shared sessions instead.

recommendation.title: Per-binding only
recommendation.body: Land only an exact-binding opt-in so every trusted group or channel is deliberately selected and all others remain isolated.

likelyOwner.reason: The routing foundation and recent resolver-cache work make this the strongest available owner for the permanent contract decision.
